newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says to take proper steps on NCB restructuring.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says to take proper steps on NCB restructuring.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) will take proper measures, while maintaining contacts with the Finance Ministry, regarding Nippon Credit Bank's restructuring efforts, a BOJ spokesman told Reuters on Thursday.
"The BOJ has not been informed of the reported restructuring plans of NCB...but will take proper steps regarding the bank's restructuring efforts," the spokesman said.
The financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Thursday that NCB may withdraw from overseas operations under a two-stage restructuring plan currently being worked out.
NCB said it will hold a news briefing at 6.15 p.m. (0915 GMT).
The BOJ spokesman said he has heard that NCB is drawing up drastic restructuring measures including the sales of its property, consolidation of its businesses and a reduction in its workforce.
